title: Grusch and the legacy reverse-engineering program

tellings.quote: So, then you have this idea of like what David Grusch may or may not have bumped into this like this legacy program.

plain: A former US intelligence officer turned whistleblower named David Grusch may have come across a "legacy program", a long-running secret effort said to recover craft of non-human origin and reverse engineer them, meaning take them apart to learn how they work. Michels raises this himself and is careful to say only that Grusch "may or may not" have run into it. If true, the US would have been quietly studying such craft for a long time.
